rows.request: Read exactly one validated Point for the target parcel from the v1.1 output.
rows.acceptance: unique ID, finite coordinates, exact blob and full 92283-feature parse gates pass

rows.request: Transform the Point with OSTN15 and record software, grid version, input CRS, output CRS and coordinates.
rows.acceptance: definitive OSTN15 path; approximate Helmert prohibited

rows.request: POST or GET layer 0 /query with f=json, geometry=<easting,northing>, geometryType=esriGeometryPoint, inSR=27700, outSR=27700, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=*, returnGeometry=true.
rows.acceptance: HTTP success, valid JSON, no service error and at least one intersecting DTM survey extent

rows.request: Run the same spatial query against layer 1 for matching DSM survey candidates.
rows.acceptance: DSM candidates retained only for contamination QA and matched by survey metadata

rows.request: Respect the advertised maximum record count of 1000; use resultOffset/resultRecordCount when transfer-limit flags require pagination and preserve every response page.
rows.acceptance: all pages collected with request timestamps and response hashes

rows.request: Request outFields=* and inspect returned field names before applying any date, resolution, transformation or geoid filters.
rows.acceptance: no guessed field names; selected attributes are copied verbatim into provenance

rows.request: Rank valid native timestamped DTM candidates by complete metadata, accepted datum, resolution preference 0.25m then 0.5m then 1m then 2m, and survey recency within the best acceptable quality class.
rows.acceptance: ranked table and deterministic selection reason published

rows.request: Use the official survey-data download path and tile identifier; retain source URL, archive checksum, GeoTIFF checksum and extraction manifest.
rows.acceptance: downloaded raster identity matches catalogue survey, date, resolution and tile extent

rows.request: Read raster size, affine transform, cell size, EPSG:27700 CRS, units, NoData value, vertical datum, survey transformation and geoidal model.
rows.acceptance: all mandatory fields available or explicitly reconciled from official survey metadata

rows.request: Select DSM and point-cloud material only when survey identity, date, transformation, geoid and spatial coverage match the primary DTM; otherwise mark diagnostic mismatch.
rows.acceptance: matching evidence or explicit non-use reason

rows.request: Apply sampling contract HD3_SC17 through HD3_SC22 and retain every accepted and rejected sample with reason codes.
rows.acceptance: minimum counts, coverage, native extrema and contamination checks pass

rows.request: Calculate max minus min and attach uncertainty budget only after all mandatory identity, boundary, datum, raster and sampling gates pass.
rows.acceptance: row-level provenance manifest and remote readback pass; otherwise numeric fields remain null
